page: OVHcloud r3-1024 is a memory-optimized server powered by an AMD EPYC processor with 128 physical cores and 128 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. It features a dedicated CPU allocation running at 2.3 GHz with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, alongside 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

In benchmark testing, the server exhibits top-tier multi-core performance, scoring in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with cached small-block reads reaching 9921.46 GB/sec and large-block reads at 276.06 GB/sec. Database and caching performance are also notable, with Redis SET operations achieving 166.68 million operations per second. However, single-core performance and large-model LLM text generation represent clear performance tradeoffs, landing in the average and poor tiers respectively.

Given its high resource density and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, the r3-1024 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that require massive parallel processing without hyperthreading overhead. It is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, and high-throughput data processing tasks.
